top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §744.2655(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's medication did not have the date that the medication was left at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that an employee who left in October 2025 was not inactivated until February 2026.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.
